steps.name: Host
steps.text: Ladies and gentlemen, may I now introduce our celebrity guest tonight—Sora!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hi there on the left! Hi there on the right! And hi there down the middle!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hi, all! I'm everyone's idol, Sora from Monster Siren Records!

steps.name: Host
steps.text: Just look at how excited they are!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I really am glad you love me so much!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But I'm sure you're all expecting our other guest who's joining us last-minute tonight, because I know I am! I'm a huge fan of hers!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Ooh, you can't wait either, can you?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Alright, let's give a big warm welcome to—Miss Nyamu!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Good even-nyamu-nyamu~!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Hello to all my fans, Nyamu here~! I'm so happy to see you all!

steps.name: Busy Security Guard
steps.text: Show me your pass! No entry without one!

steps.name: Busy Security Guard
steps.text: If you're not staff or registered, stand outside and stop squeezing through!

steps.name: Busy Security Guard
steps.text: Diu, there's just too many people!

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: Sora...! Nyamu! I love you!!

steps.name: Busy Security Guard
steps.text: Hey, stop that guy—don't let him get inside!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...This place is an utter mess.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Why are there so many people...?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...I don't see any chance of infiltrating inside.
Hey, little lady. Wanna head inside and see the stars?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Whose fan are you? Sora's, or Nyamu's?

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Whichever it is, I've got methods. I can get you in to see her.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...Why are you assisting me?

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Hey, no need to be nervous now.

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: It won't cost you that much... Yeah, here's the price.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...I don't have the money.

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Hey, this is a bargain price as is! No haggling!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: That doesn't change the fact that I don't...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: (Dubious doesn't begin to describe this man... but I really don't see any alternative right now. If I don't seize this chance...)

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: (I'll just have to trust him for now.)

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: (Digs through her pockets)

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Here, this is it... all the money I have on me. What do you make of that?

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Deal! Follow me.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Staff-only access...?

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Yeah. We'll head in through here.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What about the visitor's pass?

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Don't have any.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: So you're a staff member?

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Then how do we get in? What do you intend to do if someone catches us?!

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: I said I've got methods! You want to see the stars up close or not?

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: (Whisper) Puk gaai, he heard us...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: (Whisper) He's coming this way! We have to hurry before he—

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Hey! What the hell are you doing here?!

steps.name: Patrolling Guard & Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Wargh—!

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: I told you to be on standby with the backup equipment!

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Oh, stagehands don't matter, huh, is that your opinion? What's your plan when the prop crew needs backups and you're sitting on them, huh?!

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: You little punk, skiving off like that.

steps.name: Patrolling Guard
steps.text: Hey. No need to be so harsh. Look at her, she's scared so bad she can't even talk.

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Don't just stand there, then! Get back to the set!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Patrolling Guard
steps.text: Young lady, the set's that way...

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Don't tell her!

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Let's see her come back and beg when she can't find it! I'll dock her pay for any losses from holding us up!

steps.name: Patrolling Guard
steps.text: You gotta do your best!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: O-Okay...

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Well, go! Move it!

steps.name: Patrolling Guard
steps.text: Whoof. Hard to make a living these days, isn't it...
Hey, hey. How's the sitch over there?

steps.name: Patrolling Guard
steps.text: All good here.

steps.name: Patrolling Guard
steps.text: All good here.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Good. Keep on truckin'.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Argh—job's got me so damn busy my head's explodin'!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Nyamu's just too damn popular! Got a Nyamu fan on every corner...

steps.name: Penguin Logistics Employee
steps.text: Nyamu must be having a tough time too...

steps.name: Penguin Logistics Employee
steps.text: You know how Miss Sora gets up before the sun's risen to practice? And how she's running around place to place to repay her fans' love. She always looks beat when I see her after dark.

steps.name: Penguin Logistics Employee
steps.text: Miss Nyamu rose to stardom so quickly. Got her own channel, her acting commitments, her show bookings...

steps.name: Penguin Logistics Employee
steps.text: She used to post videos of drum practice, but lately she hasn't been uploading them at all...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You're a Nyamu-chan fan, huh?

steps.name: Penguin Logistics Employee
steps.text: Yeah... I got into drums in the first place because of her videos.

steps.name: Penguin Logistics Employee
steps.text: Sometimes I watch the old uploads when I'm feeling like giving up.

steps.name: Penguin Logistics Employee
steps.text: I wonder if she can still make music with joy these days. Like she did in The Drummer Girl.

spans.text: I wonder if she can still make music with joy these days. Like she did in

steps.name: Penguin Logistics Employee
steps.text: Uh! Sorry, I got carried away talking.

steps.name: Penguin Logistics Employee
steps.text: The most important thing is to keep Sora safe! Let's get back to work and keep our eyes sharp.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Easy there, ain't all that much stress. I got some new toys here. These babies can automatically identify unauthorized visitors—

spans.text: much stress. I got some new toys here. These babies can automatically identify unauthorized visitors—

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You're kiddin' me...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Two suspicious figures in Area A! Drones out!
Two figures run through the narrow corridor, their frantic sprint enforced by the dozens of armed drones chasing.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I should never... have trusted you!!

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: I'm just as lost as you! This never happened to anyone I sneaked in before!

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: When'd they get all this surveillance and dronepower?!

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Shoot, the drones are catching up! Run! Runnn!

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: (Strange sound)

steps.name: Strange Man
steps.text: Heheheh-heh-heh.... hah-hahahahah!!
Suddenly, the man who was accompanying Sakiko is nowhere to be seen. In his place, she finds a familiar face.

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Hahahahah-hah! This is so much fun!!

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Joyful cry)

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Well? Are you enjoying this girl's sweet dream?

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: She seems SMITTEN with all the love being showered on her. I don't think she eeeever wants to leave!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You're responsible for all this?!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: I thought I made it clear when you challenged me—this was never going to be easy.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: I demand you let me see her!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: Well, that's not hard. Just go straight down the corridor, aaaaall the way down, and you'll find her!

steps.name: Morpheus
steps.text: If I were you, though, I'd want to see about losing these things behind you first!

steps.name: Corettons
steps.text: (Chirping in agreement)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: She's runnin' towards the set! Sora's in danger! Stop her!

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: ...Dammit!
Sakiko feels the floor grow soft beneath her feet. The door ahead of her falls away for each step she makes. There seems to be no end to this nightmarish run.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Yūtenji, I want you to wake up!!

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: Track her motions, zoom in—

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: Good, a little closer, focus her face, pan over those pale lips.
'What is the meaning of a doll's existence?'
'To stand in a shop window, imitating the motions of those outside.'
'To bring laughter to people with clumsy imitation.'
'When the doll is happy, everyone smiles.'
'Even when the doll is sad, everyone smiles.'
'Now, we bid you enjoy this doll's show—'

steps.name: Voice from the Communicator
steps.text: ...Perfect.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: A-Amazing...

steps.name: Host
steps.text: I can't believe it! You were born to act!!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Heheh. I only really got a hang of this one recently.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: I practiced in front of a mirror night after night, trying to understand the thoughts of a doll.

steps.name: Host
steps.text: Understanding a doll? Wow, now that sounds pretty out there, haha...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: It must have taken so much hard work to nail the performance, Miss Nyamu!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: ...Well, I always think I've still got a long way to go.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Everyone around me is blessed with these incredible abilities.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: There's famous child actors who were born with a silver spoon in their mouth.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: There's people who fall into the deepest pits and still carry on shining bright.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: I run until I can't run anymore, just to barely catch up to them...

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: I have a trick or two up my sleeve, but in front of their talent, really, I have nothing.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: So when so many people love me, love someone so mediocre and ordinary like me, I have to work ten times harder just to answer their appreciation.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Miss Nyamu... you're incredible as is.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm sure everyone here will agree with me when I say—we all love you.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Yeah... thank you, everybody.

steps.name: Host
steps.text: What an emotional scene, folks. It's been wonderful having our two incredible guests on set this evening.

steps.name: Host
steps.text: Say, while we're in the mood, I just had a little idea—

steps.name: Host
steps.text: Will the two of you do us the honor of reenacting that classic scene from The Drummer Girl?

spans.text: Will the two of you do us the honor of reenacting that classic scene from

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji & Sora
steps.text: Sure!
Nyamu and Sora take positions, following the instructions from their earpieces.
The skies are blue. The summer breeze carries the scent of afar.
The cry of the fowlbeasts.
The sound of breathing.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: —Come down from the roof!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: No! These are my dreams! I'll shout them at the top of my voice from the highest point around!
It is the job of an idol to be the picture of perfection.
Even if it takes a little lying at times.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But—but—you only just decided to buy a drum set!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: What if you end up giving up on drums? People will laugh at you!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: I've made up my mind! I'll play drums the rest of my life! I'll play until my hands won't move anymore!
But I gave up on drums.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: My dream's to be the best drummer in Lungmen—
I did it. I became who everyone loves me for being.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: No, in all of Terra!
This is fine. I'm fine. This is the recognition I wanted, the status I wanted—
Is it? This? Is this really what I wanted?
The cry of the fowlbeasts.
The sound of breathing.
The sound of glass breaking.
A sound that shouldn't have been heard during filming.
The night's breeze is cold and indifferent, yet the mind is still murky as to all that is happening.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Host
steps.text: W-What happened?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Miss Nyamu??

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Y'all guard Sora! Someone's kidnapped Nyamu! I'm after them!
The sounds of chaos from behind grow more distant by the second.
When Nyamu finally snaps out of it, she finds herself and Sakiko together in freefall.

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: What kind of 'sweet dream' is this?

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: You lost your drums, you lost your friends, you lost yourself. Even if countless people adore you now, can you still call this your dream?

spans.text: You lost your drums, you lost your friends, you lost yourself. Even if countless people adore you now, can you still call this

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Where is my sharp-witted, silver-tongued Yūtenji-san?

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: But—but...

steps.name: Sakiko Togawa
steps.text: Nyamu. It's time to wake up.
